answer: The saffron counter is kept in umber and juniper shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 47 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 47 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 44 times over for the same share of the pool. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
